sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hi, my name's Kim Tingley.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫金·廷利。

sentences.en: I write Studies Show, which is a health column for the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》杂志撰写健康专栏“研究显示”。

sentences.en: Over the course of the past year, I ran across a lot of case studies about the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，我接触到了许多关于新冠病毒的案例研究。

sentences.en: One that really stayed with me was published in May.
sentences.zh: 其中一个让我印象深刻的研究发表于五月。

sentences.en: It was about one of the first super-spreading events of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 它讲述的是疫情中最早的超级传播事件之一。

sentences.en: And it happened at a choir practice.
sentences.zh: 发生在一场合唱排练中。

sentences.en: Usually these studies are really dry, but they're always full of details.
sentences.zh: 通常这些研究非常枯燥，但总是充满了细节。

sentences.en: Human details.
sentences.zh: 关于人的细节。

sentences.en: And those jumped out to me.
sentences.zh: 而这些细节深深吸引了我。

sentences.en: Like, someone brought oranges to the rehearsal as a snack to share.
sentences.zh: 比如，有人带了橙子到排练现场作为零食分享。

sentences.en: A few members showed up early to set up the folding chairs.
sentences.zh: 几位成员提前到达，摆放折叠椅。

sentences.en: It got me wondering about who these people were.
sentences.zh: 这让我好奇这些人是谁。

sentences.en: What it was like for them to experience a tragedy that also made them really important to science.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，经历一场既是悲剧又让他们对科学变得如此重要的事件，是什么样的感受？

sentences.en: And that brought them national attention.
sentences.zh: 这也让他们受到了全国的关注。

sentences.en: Some of it negative.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是负面的。

sentences.en: People were like,
sentences.zh: 人们会说，

sentences.en: Choir practice?
sentences.zh: 合唱排练？

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Here's what happens in your body when you sing.
sentences.zh: 当你唱歌时，身体会发生这样的变化。

sentences.en: Your whole respiratory tract is lined with mucus.
sentences.zh: 你的整个呼吸道内衬着粘液。

sentences.en: So when you exhale deeply, as singers are taught to do, tiny tubes in your lungs called bronchioles collapse.
sentences.zh: 所以当你像歌手被教导的那样深呼气时，肺部被称为细支气管的微小管道会塌陷。

sentences.en: When you inhale, those walls pull apart, creating a bubble of mucus that pops.
sentences.zh: 当你吸气时，这些管壁拉开，形成一个会破裂的粘液气泡。

sentences.en: That pop generates a mist of tiny particles called aerosols that you then exhale on your next outbreath.
sentences.zh: 那个破裂会产生一团微小的颗粒雾，即气溶胶，你在下一次呼气时将其呼出。

sentences.en: And those don't fall within a few feet of you the way larger droplets can.
sentences.zh: 它们不会像较大的飞沫那样落在你几英尺内。

sentences.en: They can stay aloft and move through the air.
sentences.zh: 它们可以保持悬浮并在空气中移动。

sentences.en: The Skagit Choir, on the night of March 10th, 2020, had 61 people indoors.
sentences.zh: 2020年3月10日晚，斯卡吉特合唱团有61人在室内。

sentences.en: All singing together.
sentences.zh: 都在一起唱歌。

sentences.en: So here's my story, voices carry.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的故事，歌声传播。

sentences.en: The Skagit Valley Chorale last sang together in person on the evening of March 10th, 2020.
sentences.zh: 斯卡吉特谷合唱团最后一次面对面合唱是在2020年3月10日晚上。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, Skagit County issued a news release on its website recommending the cancellation of gatherings of more than 10 people.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，斯卡吉特县在其网站上发布了一份新闻稿，建议取消超过10人的聚会。

sentences.en: But the Chorale didn't see the advisory in time.
sentences.zh: 但合唱团没能及时看到这条建议。

sentences.en: The Valley, a rural expanse in northwestern Washington, cupped between the Puget Sound and the North Cascades, doesn't have a dedicated TV station.
sentences.zh: 这个山谷位于华盛顿州西北部，夹在普吉特湾和北喀斯喀特山脉之间，没有专门的电视台。

sentences.en: And county officials rely on radio, the Skagit Valley Herald, and Skagit Breaking, an online news site, to carry announcements.
sentences.zh: 县官员依靠广播、《斯卡吉特谷先驱报》和在线新闻网站《斯卡吉特突发新闻》来发布公告。

sentences.en: Whenever I put out news releases,
sentences.zh: 每当我发布新闻稿时，

sentences.en: I'm expecting behavior change and common knowledge not to happen for days,
sentences.zh: 我预料到行为改变和常识普及不会在几天内发生，

sentences.en: Leah Hamner, the communicable disease and epidemiology lead for the county's public health department, told me.
sentences.zh: 县公共卫生部门的传染病和流行病学负责人莉亚·汉纳告诉我。

sentences.en: Businesses, schools, restaurants, and other public spaces were open as usual.
sentences.zh: 企业、学校、餐馆和其他公共场所照常开放。

sentences.en: Mary Campbell, a tenor who worked as the district manager for the libraries in a neighboring county, spent the day in discussions about how to keep staff and patrons
sentences.zh: 玛丽·坎贝尔是一位女高音，在邻县担任图书馆区域经理，她花了一整天时间讨论如何让员工和读者

sentences.en: safe from touching things, like return books.
sentences.zh: 避免接触诸如归还书籍之类的物品。

sentences.en: She showed up at practice feeling stressed and tired, but knowing that two and a half hours of singing with the group would,
sentences.zh: 她来到排练现场时感到压力很大且疲惫，但她知道与团队一起唱歌两个半小时，

sentences.en: through alchemy everyone felt but couldn't quite explain, give her uplift and energy.
sentences.zh: 通过一种每个人都能感受到却无法完全解释的炼金术，会给她带来振奋和能量。

sentences.en: The Chorale is rehearsing for its April concert, which often overlaps with the Valley's annual Tulip Festival,
sentences.zh: 合唱团正在为四月份的音乐会排练，这通常与山谷一年一度的郁金香节重叠，

sentences.en: an event that features fields blooming in red, pink, and yellow flowers, and traffic jams of admiring tourists.
sentences.zh: 那是一个以盛开的红、粉、黄色花田和慕名而来的游客造成的交通拥堵为特色的活动。

sentences.en: The practice that night was optional.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上的排练是自愿参加的。

sentences.en: The group's board, along with its artistic director and conductor,
sentences.zh: 该团的董事会，连同其艺术总监兼指挥，

sentences.en: Adam Burdick, had been closely watching for local, state, and national alerts since the end of February, when a soprano named Nancy Hamilton emailed Burdick
sentences.zh: 亚当·伯迪克，自二月底以来一直密切关注当地、州和国家的警报，当时一位名叫南希·汉密尔顿的女高音给伯迪克发了电子邮件，

sentences.en: to raise the question of whether they should wear masks.
sentences.zh: 提出了他们是否应该戴口罩的问题。

sentences.en: Hard to sing with a mask on, she observed.
sentences.zh: 她观察到，戴着口罩唱歌很难。

sentences.en: After consulting the website of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention,
sentences.zh: 在咨询了疾病控制与预防中心的网站后，

sentences.en: Burdick replied, copying members of the board, to say that masks were recommended only for first responders and people who were sick.
sentences.zh: 伯迪克回复并抄送了董事会成员，称口罩仅建议急救人员和生病的人佩戴。

sentences.en: The Chorale's co-presidents, exercising what they understood to be an abundance of caution, emailed the membership before their weekly practice on March 3rd
sentences.zh: 合唱团的联席主席们出于他们所理解的极其谨慎的态度，在3月3日的每周排练前给成员发了电子邮件，

sentences.en: to urge anyone with any symptoms or fears of being at greater risk of harm from the coronavirus to stay home in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 敦促任何有症状或担心因新冠病毒而面临更大伤害风险的人在未来几周内留在家中。

sentences.en: The Chorale would put the music and recordings of the practice sessions online.
sentences.zh: 合唱团会将排练的音乐和录音放在网上。

sentences.en: Hamilton, who was 83, decided to go on the 10th.
sentences.zh: 83岁的汉密尔顿决定在10号去参加。

sentences.en: So did Carol Ray Woodmancy, an alto who was a few years younger and had sung with the Chorale for more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔·雷·伍德曼西也去了，她是一位比汉密尔顿年轻几岁的中音，在合唱团唱了十多年。

sentences.en: Her daughter had begged her to stay home because she had recently been through radiation treatment, but singing was Woodmancy's passion and she said she didn't want to live scared.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿曾恳求她留在家中，因为她最近刚做完放射治疗，但唱歌是伍德曼西的热情所在，她说她不想活在恐惧中。

sentences.en: At the time, the outbreak in Washington appeared to be largely confined to a nursing home near Seattle, an hour to the south of them.
sentences.zh: 当时，华盛顿州的疫情似乎主要局限在他们以南一小时车程的西雅图附近的一家疗养院。

sentences.en: But it was starting to seem that this strange disease they were hearing about could migrate north and halt activities for a while, according to Susan Easthouse,
sentences.zh: 但据那天晚上参加排练的女高音苏珊·伊斯特豪斯说，他们听说的那种奇怪疾病似乎开始向北蔓延并可能暂时停止活动。

sentences.en: a tenor who attended that night.
sentences.zh: “3月10日那天，我们大多数人都在想，趁还能唱就唱吧，”她告诉我。

sentences.en: Most of us on March 10th were thinking, let's sing while we still can, she told me.
sentences.zh: 合唱团成立于1984年，当时有30名成员。

sentences.en: The Chorale started in 1984 with 30 members.
sentences.zh: 现在大约有120人，还有10个名额，这个数字部分取决于有多少人能安全地站在弗农山表演艺术中心的看台上，

sentences.en: Now there are about 120, with room for 10 more, a number determined in part by how many people can safely fit on the risers at the Performing Arts Center in Mount Vernon,
sentences.zh: 那是他们举办音乐会的地方。

sentences.en: where the concerts take place.
sentences.zh: 洛伊斯·范德穆伦是唯一还在合唱团的创始成员，她告诉我，加入合唱团不需要会看乐谱，只要能跟上调子就行。

sentences.en: Lois Vandermulen, the only charter member still with the choir, told me that you don't have to read music to belong, you just have to carry a tune.
sentences.zh: 她在40多岁时加入，现在77岁了。

sentences.en: She joined in her early 40s and is 77 now.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·爱默生也是如此，他13年前去听了一场音乐会，对自己说，那一定很有趣，然后就报名了。

sentences.en: So is Roger Emerson, who went to a concert 13 years ago, said to himself, that would be fun, and then signed up.
sentences.zh: 大多数成员都在65岁以上。

sentences.en: Most members are over 65.
sentences.zh: 有教育工作者、医生、工程师、艺术家、农民。

sentences.en: Educators, doctors, engineers, artists, farmers.
sentences.zh: 许多人已经退休，但也有年轻的在职专业人士，甚至还有一对十几岁的兄妹。

sentences.en: Many are retired, but there are younger working professionals, even a pair of siblings in their late teens.
sentences.zh: 有夫妻，也有与成年子女一起唱歌的父母。

sentences.en: There are couples, as well as parents, who sing together with their grown children.
sentences.zh: 当地政治观点分歧很大，但在排练时从不讨论，排练本身就很专注，几乎没有闲聊的时间。

sentences.en: Local politics is split down the middle and never discussed at rehearsals, which are intensely focused anyway with little time for chit-chat.
sentences.zh: 团里有些人是造诣深厚的音乐家，有些人则是初学者。

sentences.en: Some in the group are accomplished musicians, others are beginners.
sentences.zh: 庞大的规模使得这种混合成为可能。

sentences.en: Sheer size makes this mix possible.
sentences.zh: 正如女高音范德穆伦对我所说，有一百个人，你只需要动动嘴唇就行了。

sentences.en: As Vandermulen, a soprano, put it to me, with a hundred people, you could just move your lips.
sentences.zh: 3月10日，三名合唱队员像往常一样提前到达了排练的教堂，

sentences.en: Three choristers arrived at the church where they practiced early on March 10th, as they typically did,
sentences.zh: 从滚动架上取下折叠椅，在联谊厅摆好。

sentences.en: to take folding chairs down from a rolling rack and set them up in the fellowship hall.
sentences.zh: 其余的人在下午6点30分前几分钟到达。

sentences.en: The rest arrived a few minutes before 6.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 外门像往常一样敞开着，方便人们进入，所以很少有人需要接触门把手。

sentences.en: The exterior doors were propped open, as usual, for people to enter, so few needed to touch a door handle.
sentences.zh: 室内提供了洗手液。

sentences.en: Hand sanitizer was available inside.
sentences.zh: 没有人拥抱。

sentences.en: Nobody hugged.
sentences.zh: 大厅对于120人来说很拥挤，但只来了61人，包括伯迪克和伴奏，这使得每个人都能坐得更开一些。

sentences.en: The hall was a tight squeeze for 120, but only 61 showed up, including Burdick and the accompanist, which enabled everyone to sit farther apart.
sentences.zh: 晚上很冷，但过了一会儿，他们的身体温暖了空间，暖通空调系统关闭了。

sentences.en: The evening was chilly, but after a while, their bodies warmed the space and the HVAC system shut off.
sentences.zh: 伯迪克以犹他州作曲家莱恩·约翰逊的一首名为《继续歌唱》的轻快曲目开始。

sentences.en: Burdick began with a buoyant piece by Lane Johnson, a composer in Utah, called Sing On.
sentences.zh: 40分钟后，他和伴奏以及男低音和男高音移步到教堂圣殿，坐在长椅上练习。

sentences.en: After 40 minutes, he and the accompanist and the basses and tenors moved to the church sanctuary, where they sat in pews to practice.
sentences.zh: 女中音和女高音继续她们的练习，其中一人弹奏钢琴。

sentences.en: The altos and sopranos kept going on their own, while one among them played the piano.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点，他们休息了10分钟。

sentences.en: At 8 p.m., they took a 10-minute break.
sentences.zh: 少数人使用了洗手间。

sentences.en: A handful used the restroom.
sentences.zh: 大约一半人吃了别人带来的橙子作为零食。

sentences.en: About half of them ate some oranges someone had brought for a snack.
sentences.zh: 他们花了最后50分钟一起排练。

sentences.en: They spent the last 50 minutes rehearsing together.
sentences.zh: 然后，有能力的人把椅子搬回架子上。

sentences.en: Then those who were able carried the chairs back to the rack.
sentences.zh: 大多数人在晚上9点左右离开。

sentences.en: Most departed around 9 p.m.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，3月11日，星期三，

sentences.en: The next morning, Wednesday, March 11th,
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州州长杰伊·英斯利禁止了三个县超过250人的聚会。

sentences.en: Washington's governor, Jay Inslee, banned gatherings of more than 250 people in three counties.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，NBA暂停了赛季。

sentences.en: That evening, the NBA suspended its season.
sentences.zh: 伍德曼西的儿子乔终于让她同意在当局理清风险之前跳过以后的排练。

sentences.en: Woodman C.'s son, Joe, finally got her to agree to skip further practices until the authorities sorted out the risks.
sentences.zh: 到周六，董事会做出了痛苦的决定，取消合唱团的春季音乐会并无限期停止排练。

sentences.en: Ruth Backlund and her husband, Mark, who were in their early 70s and attended practice, developed fevers on Friday, March 13th.
sentences.zh: 与巴克伦德一起担任合唱团联席主席的卡罗琳·康斯托克和她的丈夫、另一位合唱团成员吉姆·欧文也发烧了。

sentences.en: So did Carolyn Comstock, who is the chorale co-president along with Backlund, and her husband, Jim Owen, another choir member.

sentences.zh: 他67岁。

sentences.en: Then Carol Ray Woodmancy.
